Order service logs confirming pool acquisition wait or exhaustion errors
candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (size 5, idle 0), causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle values come from trace attributes only; order-side metrics and logs were excluded from context, so saturation is inferred rather than directly measured.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with DependencyUnavailable and pool size 5/idle 0, propagating as order 503 and gateway ReadTimeout/502. Inventory and payment calls succeed, ruling out redis-timeout and downstream-latency. Order deployment record only establishes version 1.0.0 and does not establish causation.
